title: Naalu agent Z'eu: one text, tactical action UI
description: Z'eu (Prophecy of Kings printing, the card a PoK game deals the Naalu) was worded differently in the Components menu (the dealt card: 'ACTION: exhaust ... a tactical action in a non-home system without placing a command token') and in the faction overview (the sheet's Thunder's Edge printing: 'return that token to reinforcements'). The faction card now shows the printing the seat holds. Z'eu's system choice also was a generic choice dialog because of its Decline option; it now is the tactical action's activation step (highlighted hexes, activation bar, Decline button), after which the normal movement tray runs. Before shots are taken at 80ce1bf1 with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before.

notes.title: How the agent works
notes.text: Component action component|leader|naaluagent -> Game::perform_zeu asks zeu_activate_system (activate options for non-home systems without the Naalu token, plus Decline); the answer exhausts the agent and begin_free_tactical runs the standard tactical action (movement_step, commit, invasion) without a command token. Client-only change, no rules version.
